# Recomp

> Local-first iOS physique check-in app for progress photos. Scrub between dates, align poses, keep photos on your device. No AI body-fat estimates. Free. iOS only.

- [Home](https://progressphotos.app/): Product landing page
- [Blog](https://progressphotos.app/blog/): Articles on progress photos and recomp tracking
- [How to Take Progress Photos for a Recomp (Cut or Bulk)](https://progressphotos.app/blog/how-to-take-progress-photos-for-recomp/): Published guide — lighting, poses, cadence, reviewing a flat scale
- [Why I Built Recomp](https://progressphotos.app/blog/why-i-built-recomp/): Founder post — weekly progress photos, comparison, and why the app exists
- [Compare and Align Progress Photos Side by Side | Recomp](https://progressphotos.app/features/compare-progress-photos/): Line up two progress photos while you compare them in Recomp. Pan, pinch and rotate either photo in one gesture, and it saves when you lift your finger.
- [Scrub Through Your Progress Photos by Date | Recomp](https://progressphotos.app/features/scrub-progress-photos/): Tap a date in Recomp's Compare screen and drag through every check-in, with a haptic tick on each and your weight chart under the ruler.
- [Progress Photo Timeline: Fling Through Years of Check-Ins | Recomp](https://progressphotos.app/features/progress-photo-timeline/): Fling Recomp's timeline and watch years of progress photos change at every check-in, like a flip-book of your own body. Small thumbnails keep it smooth.
- [Progress Photo Ghost Overlay Camera, Coming in 3.6 | Recomp](https://progressphotos.app/features/ghost-overlay-camera/): Coming in Recomp 3.6: an in-app camera that shows your last photo of the same pose as a see-through ghost, so each new check-in starts closer to the last.
- [Why Progress Photo Auto-Alignment Is Hard to Do Well | Recomp](https://progressphotos.app/blog/progress-photo-auto-alignment/): Finding a body in a photo is easy. Lining up years of progress photos without faking change isn't. What breaks, and why I align by hand.
- [About](https://progressphotos.app/about/): Mark Stepchin, independent developer
- [Privacy](https://progressphotos.app/privacy/): App data never leaves the device; no upload
- [FAQ](https://progressphotos.app/faq/): Short answers (longer FAQ coming)
- [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/recomp-progress-photo-tracker/id6760444125): Download Recomp for iPhone
